entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: One of three gods captured and distorted by Nicol Bolas; an insect god of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Captured and distorted the gods to serve his interests.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: Something the Locust God was meant to consume and destroy; rebuilt by Hazoret.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: God who rebuilt the Hekma and ignited Phyrexian oil with her spear.

entities.name: Scarab God
entities.description: Fellow insect god engaged with the Phyrexian invaders.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City on Amonkhet where the insect gods fought Phyrexians.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Led a crop of elite fighters to dismember the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Ketramose
entities.description: Later god regarded by the insect gods as tainted.

events.summary: The Locust God was confined outside Naktamun after Hazoret rebuilt the Hekma.
events.quote: the Locust God was confined outside Naktamun

events.summary: The survivors found the Scarab God and Locust God at Naktamun fighting the Phyrexians, and Hazoret ignited the Phyrexians' oil.
events.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins

events.summary: Djeru led elite fighters to dismember the Phyrexians; the insect gods then departed for the deep desert.
events.quote: the inscrutable insect gods departed for the deep desert without a word

events.summary: After the God-Pharaoh's death the Scarab and Locust Gods showed agency, viewing themselves as true gods.
events.quote: They saw themselves as the true gods of the plane

relations.quote: captured and distorted by Nicol Bolas to serve his interests
the Chitin Court , as they are termed
